## Stale-prose honesty on read surfaces: symbol reads and file triefact views now… — 2026-07-25 (parent 5a31f390626c)

Adds two-layer staleness warnings to symbol read and file triefact view surfaces, plus fixes the CLI read renderer to display notes it previously dropped silently.

`SymbolDetail` gains a `body_normalized_hash` field (from `get_symbol_detail`) representing the source fingerprint at last scan. Three new helpers drive the staleness logic:

- `_staleness_notes` — produces warning strings for one symbol, checking both layers
- `_section_fingerprint` — extracts a sentinel fingerprint from a triefact section via `SECTION_OPEN_RE`
- `_stale_qnames_for_file` — returns the set of qnames whose sentinel fingerprint mismatches the symbols table

`_read_symbol` prepends these notes to the read envelope; `_triefact_view` prefixes a stale-sections banner in compact and full views. `_render_read` now prints the `notes` field early (bold yellow for warnings, dim otherwise) instead of ignoring it. Three new tests (`test_read_warns_when_prose_is_stale`, `test_read_warns_when_graph_itself_is_stale`, `test_read_has_no_stale_warning_when_fresh`) cover all cases.

### Changes

- ~ trie/graph/store:SymbolDetail — New fingerprint field: body_normalized_hash from the last scan, selected in get_symbol_detail.
- + trie/mcp_server:TrieTools._staleness_notes — "Return warning strings when `TrieTools` detects that prose being served no longer reflects the current source."
- + trie/mcp_server:TrieTools._section_fingerprint — "Return the source fingerprint stamped in `detail`'s triefact section sentinel, or `None` when the triefact or section is absent."
- + trie/mcp_server:TrieTools._stale_qnames_for_file — "Return the set of qnames in `rel` whose triefact section fingerprint differs from the current symbols-table hash, indicating stale prose."
- ~ trie/mcp_server:TrieTools._read_symbol — Prepends staleness notes to the read envelope.
- ~ trie/mcp_server:TrieTools._triefact_view — Prefixes a stale-sections banner into compact and full file views.
- ~ trie/cli:_render_read — "Renders human-readable output for `trie read` command responses, displaying symbol metadata, prose, pending patches, and caller/callee relationships." → "Renders human-readable output for `trie read` command responses, displaying symbol metadata, notes (before prose), prose, pending patches, and caller/callee…"
- + tests/test_mcp:test_read_has_no_stale_warning_when_fresh — "Assert that `TrieTools.read` emits no stale warnings when prose and graph are both current."
- + tests/test_mcp:test_read_warns_when_graph_itself_is_stale — "Assert that `TrieTools.read` includes a graph-stale warning when source is edited without a subsequent re-scan."
- + tests/test_mcp:test_read_warns_when_prose_is_stale — "Assert that `TrieTools.read` attaches a `STALE` note to a symbol whose prose predates a source edit followed by a re-scan, and that the compact file view also…"
